sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Let us Read 4 The Wise Parrot In a quiet village, a rich merchant kept a bright and talkative parrot in a cage of gold.
sections.source_evidence: Let us Read 4 The Wise Parrot In a quiet village, a rich merchant kept a bright and talkative parrot in a cage of gold.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: The parrot had a sharp mind and often entertained the merchant with stories and songs.
sections.source_evidence: The parrot had a sharp mind and often entertained the merchant with stories and songs.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: However, deep inside, the bird longed for the open skies and green trees.
sections.source_evidence: However, deep inside, the bird longed for the open skies and green trees.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: One day, the merchant decided to travel far away for business.
sections.source_evidence: One day, the merchant decided to travel far away for business.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: He thought he would do something to please his pet.
sections.source_evidence: He thought he would do something to please his pet.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: He walked up to the cage and said, “My beloved parrot, I am about to travel to a far-off land.
sections.source_evidence: He walked up to the cage and said, “My beloved parrot, I am about to travel to a far-off land.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: 42 Santoor Grade 5 The parrot replied, “Dear master, you look after my needs so well that I have tasted all the tender fruits and chillies.
sections.source_evidence: 42 Santoor Grade 5 The parrot replied, “Dear master, you look after my needs so well that I have tasted all the tender fruits and chillies.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: But, I want to taste the joy of flying in the sky.
sections.source_evidence: But, I want to taste the joy of flying in the sky.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: If you really want me to be happy, please let me fly off into the sky.” The merchant said, “You are very dear to me and I cannot bear to let you go away.
sections.source_evidence: If you really want me to be happy, please let me fly off into the sky.” The merchant said, “You are very dear to me and I cannot bear to let you go away.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: Ask for anything else.” The bird sighed.
sections.source_evidence: Ask for anything else.” The bird sighed.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: “Since you cannot let me fly, when you see my friends in the jungle tell them that I send them greetings from my cage.” The merchant went off on his travels.
sections.source_evidence: “Since you cannot let me fly, when you see my friends in the jungle tell them that I send them greetings from my cage.” The merchant went off on his travels.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: One day in a forest, he saw a flight of parrots with the same colour as his pet.
sections.source_evidence: One day in a forest, he saw a flight of parrots with the same colour as his pet.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: He walked up to the tree and said, “O beautiful parrots, I have one of your relatives as a pet and I keep it in a cage of gold.
sections.source_evidence: He walked up to the tree and said, “O beautiful parrots, I have one of your relatives as a pet and I keep it in a cage of gold.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: It has sent greetings for you all.” As the merchant finished speaking, one parrot dropped like a stone from the tree and fell on the ground.
sections.source_evidence: It has sent greetings for you all.” As the merchant finished speaking, one parrot dropped like a stone from the tree and fell on the ground.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: 43 The Wise Parrot The merchant was distressed at this.
sections.source_evidence: 43 The Wise Parrot The merchant was distressed at this.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: On returning home, he went up to his parrot’s cage and described all the wonders and the beauty he had seen on his journey, and how a flight of parrots had come to the forest he was visiting.
sections.source_evidence: On returning home, he went up to his parrot’s cage and described all the wonders and the beauty he had seen on his journey, and how a flight of parrots had come to the forest he was visiting.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: He then told his pet about the message he had conveyed, and, with great sorrow, described how one bird had been so shocked that it fell to the ground.
sections.source_evidence: He then told his pet about the message he had conveyed, and, with great sorrow, described how one bird had been so shocked that it fell to the ground.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: As soon as he finished talking, his own pet parrot fell from the perch to the floor of the cage.
sections.source_evidence: As soon as he finished talking, his own pet parrot fell from the perch to the floor of the cage.

sections.heading: Learning Point 19
sections.content: 44 Santoor Grade 5 The merchant couldn’t understand how his beloved pet died so suddenly.
sections.source_evidence: 44 Santoor Grade 5 The merchant couldn’t understand how his beloved pet died so suddenly.

sections.heading: Learning Point 20
sections.content: He reached into the cage and gently took the still warm body of the bird and placed it on the windowsill.
sections.source_evidence: He reached into the cage and gently took the still warm body of the bird and placed it on the windowsill.
